detail.longDescription: I have a very simple script that is supposed to download multiple repos simultaneously. But I am having trouble even getting one working. $blah = Start-Job { git clone https://github.com/davidalayachew/DarkestDungeonPathFinder } Receive-Job -Wait -Job $blah This makes powershell throw an error, but the errors are showing the downloading logs, like 1% downloaded , 2% downloaded , and so on. It's almost like powershell is trying to parse the download progress messages as a command, and failing to. I tried saving the output, amongst other strategies, but nothing worked. What am I doing wrong?
